name: crt-anime-mv
description: Build a beat-synced 1080p anime music video whose whole world is an old CRT phosphor terminal, rendered with Canvas 2D or HyperFrames.

interface.shortDescription: Beat-synced anime MV rendered as a CRT terminal.
interface.longDescription: Produces a 1920x1080 30 fps music video in which the entire visual world is an old CRT terminal: green phosphor code, lyrics rendered as terminal log output, live mathematical diagrams, and an anime character composited out of the glass. The pipeline measures the real tempo and per-beat energy, builds a beat-locked timeline from an LRC file, tints a transparent character cutout into a phosphor palette, keeps text crisp by compositing it after all post-processing, renders frames deterministically in parallel, and verifies the result with objective sync and integrity tests. The same composition can instead be authored as HTML + CSS + GSAP and rendered with the external HyperFrames CLI, whose built-in lint, layout, contrast and motion gates complement this skill's beat-modulation and audio-integrity checks.
